newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta dockyard in Norwegian marketing drive.
newsitem.headline: Malta dockyard in Norwegian marketing drive.

text.p: Malta Drydocks is planning to seek ship repair work in the Norwegian market and carry out a "deep marketing exercise" there shortly, the Malta Department of Information said at the weekend.
It was reporting on a meeting between Transport and Ports Minister Joe Debono Grech and Alf Roldsen, master of the Norwegian tanker Century, which is being repaired at Malta Drydocks.
The Century is the first Norwegian vessel to be repaired at the dockyard since 1994.
A report on Malta Drydocks commissioned by the government earlier this year identified Scandinavia as one of the markets the shipyard had lost over recent years.

The loss-making state dockyard has been undergoing reform since election of a new Labour government on October 26. Its management, formerly in the hands of the workforce, has now effectively gone into the government's hands.
